playstyle.identity: Nilah is a melee ADC who shares bonus XP with her support. She has incredible sustain and can dodge abilities with her mist, scaling into a late-game monster.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive shares XP and amplifies healing/shielding from allies. Q empowers autos with range and cleave. W creates a mist that dodges autos. E dashes through targets. R pulls enemies in and damages/heals. Play aggressively with W protection.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Nilah spikes faster than other ADCs due to shared XP. Infinity Edge and crit scale her. She's a late-game hypercarry who outlevels opponents.

passive.name: Joy Unending
passive.summary: Share bonus XP with support; amplify healing and shielding received.
passive.details: When Nilah last-hits minions, she and her nearest ally gain additional experience. She also amplifies healing and shielding from allies.

abilities.name: Formless Blade
abilities.summary: Empower autos to cleave and gain range.
abilities.details: Passive: Nilah's Q and autos heal her, amplified on crit. Active: Nilah whips her blade, gaining bonus range and causing attacks to deal damage in a cone.

abilities.name: Jubilant Veil
abilities.summary: Create a mist that dodges auto attacks.
abilities.details: Nilah shrouds herself in mist, gaining movement speed and causing auto attacks against her to miss. Can touch an ally to share the effect.

abilities.name: Slipstream
abilities.summary: Dash through a target, damaging enemies passed.
abilities.details: Nilah dashes through a target unit, dealing damage to enemies she passes through. Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Apotheosis
abilities.summary: Pull enemies in, deal damage, and heal based on damage dealt.
abilities.details: Nilah whirls her blade, pulling nearby enemies toward her center and dealing damage. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt.
